headline: South African Telecom Locks $67 Million in Kenya Following Stake Void
summary: Vodacom stated that $67 million of Kenyan dividends remains locked at Stanbic Bank Kenya after a court voided a 15% Safaricom stake sale, with an appeal pending.
why: Cross-border capital mobility and legal enforceability of share transactions are critical factors for multinational corporations operating in regional African markets.

impacts.name: Vodacom Group
impacts.why: Legal disputes and blocked dividend repatriations restrict capital flows for the operator.
